title: Beverage Formulation
description: Water-soluble terpene blends engineered for functional beverages. Our nano-emulsion technology ensures stable dispersion, consistent flavor, and rapid bioavailability across sparkling water, kombucha, and spirit-free cocktail applications.

title: Cannabis Terpene Innovation
description: Strain-specific and effect-targeted terpene profiles for vaporizer cartridges, edibles, and concentrates. Our library of 300+ botanical terpene formulations enables precise sensory and functional customization.

title: Flavor Systems
description: Natural terpene-derived flavor compounds for food and beverage manufacturers. Replace synthetic flavoring with clean-label, plant-derived alternatives that meet consumer demand for transparency and sustainability.

title: Ingredient R&D
description: Custom terpene isolation, characterization, and formulation services. Our analytical chemistry team works alongside your product developers from proof-of-concept through scale-up and regulatory documentation.

title: Aroma Engineering
description: Precision-crafted scent profiles for personal care, home fragrance, and wellness products. Terpene-based aromatic formulations offer natural alternatives to petrochemical-derived fragrance compounds.

title: Agricultural Bioactives
description: Terpene-based biopesticides and plant growth modulators for sustainable agriculture. Our formulations leverage the natural pest-deterrent and signaling properties of plant terpenes to reduce synthetic chemical dependency.

title: Topical & Transdermal Delivery
description: Terpene-enhanced penetration systems for topical and transdermal therapeutic products. Specific terpenes increase skin permeability, improving active ingredient absorption without harsh chemical enhancers.

title: White-Label Formulation
description: Turnkey terpene blend development for brands seeking rapid market entry. From concept through compliance, we provide ready-to-manufacture formulations with full documentation and regulatory support.

title: Analytical Services
description: GC-MS terpene profiling, potency testing, and quality assurance for raw materials and finished products. Our ISO-accredited laboratory delivers precise compositional analysis with rapid turnaround.

title: Encapsulation Technology
description: Microencapsulation and controlled-release systems for volatile terpene compounds. Protect sensitive molecules through processing, extend shelf life, and enable targeted release in the final application.
